purpose: Curated homograph candidate senses for the WordGraph (ADR-010). Hand content — reviewed, never generated. The generator consumes this file and marks every lexeme 'unresolved' with the candidate senses listed; a split is made only when a conflicting occurrence appears in scope (e.g. H7673 'keep' in Exodus), at which point this file is updated through the review workflow. Theological prose per lexeme is deliberately deferred.
provenance: Candidate senses come from TBESH multi-variant records indicating a distinct second root. H7307's 'wind' is the Strong's sense (TBESH lists only spirit variants) — the dual provenance is intentional.
